recipe.observation: 3 shots, mean 8 s, shortest 7.5 s, longest 9 s (slow cadence)
recipe.viewer_effect: Reads as unhurried and premium; attention is held on one continuous surface.
recipe.transferable_mechanic: Long takes that travel through the product instead of cutting away.

recipe.observation: Energy arc peaks mid-film (peak at shot 2 of 3, 0.5)
recipe.viewer_effect: A mid peak gives a clear climax and a graceful resolve.
recipe.transferable_mechanic: Place the boldest move in the middle and resolve with a calm hold.

recipe.observation: Motion pattern: slow dolly through the product
recipe.viewer_effect: Continuous camera travel hides the joins and feels premium.
recipe.transferable_mechanic: One camera path carries the viewer through consecutive states.

recipe.observation: Motion pattern: cursor hover then click
recipe.viewer_effect: A visible pointer gives the screen a cause and a protagonist.
recipe.transferable_mechanic: The cursor hesitates, hunts and clicks, and the UI responds to it.

recipe.observation: Motion pattern: panel expand to become the next screen
recipe.viewer_effect: A real component growing into the screen makes the product feel spatial.
recipe.transferable_mechanic: A UI component expands to become the next environment.
